global_organization_chain: Open on the dilemma, stepping stone or devil
Define equity by no-envy, then reject the unweighted Theil with a reductio
Show cooperation is privately rational and globally unequal
Repair the gap with a Shapley tilt, and name the economic channel
Answer the UN Charter clause by clause

main_argument_chains.claim: Mining pioneers will cooperate for profit, and that closed cooperation widens inequity unless the gains are allocated with only a small edge to capable countries.
support_steps: Map the no-envy definition from persons to countries
Reject the unweighted Theil because it equates the United States with the Vatican
Score national power with three factors explaining more than 80 percent
Show cooperative-competition profit exceeds Nash profit
Show a one-country Lucky shock spikes the between-group Theil index
Allocate at scaled Shapley weights 0.6437 and 0.5982
Show the Theil index falls, most between capable and incapable countries
Attribute the effect to GDP, trade, and income per capita
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Quote the UN Charter and answer each clause with a mining rule: no weapons, small-state participation, legal aid, quotas, and livelihood use of the technology.

warnings.warning: Equations (1)-(3) print as blank lines. Classic, population-weighted, and log-corrected Theil forms were reconstructed from the prose (y income, N population, n country population, k country count) and the standard identities. The exact log correction is not recoverable.
Equation (6), the cooperative-competition profit, is OCR-blank. Only the prose comparison survives: cooperative-competition benefits exceed full-competition benefits.

The Shapley block survives as sentence fragments ('means that the overall return v must be above some lower bound'). Superadditivity and the zero-if-no-mining constraint are taken from those fragments, not from a readable formula.
